title: The phUSD bank survives the terminal emergencyTransfer ejector seat and remains a live, permissionless, un-pause-gated claim on FRESH phUSD supply after the contract has been swept and paused
description: claimUnclaimablePhUSD (:644) is `external nonReentrant` with NO whenNotPaused modifier, so the pause does not stop it; and because the tokens were never minted, emergencyTransfer's balance sweep cannot reach them. The stable and promo banks die with the sweep; the phUSD bank does not. The asymmetry is real and is the whole footgun: after the terminal ejector seat has fired and the contract is swept and paused, the phUSD bank remains a live permissionless claim that mints FRESH, unbacked supply.
impact: Fresh unbacked phUSD minted post-termination; dilution of phUSD holders. PoC-backed.
attackPath: No attacker. The claimant claims exactly what the contract records as owed.
Harm is an owner wind-down oversight: the owner fires the terminal ejector seat believing the contract is finished, and the phUSD bank silently outlives it.
gating: Double-gated: the terminal ejector seat fires (rare, protocol-ending) AND a non-empty residual phUSD bank -- on a reward stream that is OFF at the shipped config (triple, counting the DEDUP-04 dormancy).
recommendation: RUNBOOK framing, deliberately NOT a code change inside emergencyTransfer: before/alongside firing emergencyTransfer, settle or explicitly zero the phUSD bank. Keep this framing exactly as written.

ejectorSeatCompliance.principle: Per the standing project principle, emergencyTransfer/pauseWithdraw are EJECTOR SEATS BY DESIGN (terminal, story-022 'recovery out-of-band'). Never propose accounting inside them.
ejectorSeatCompliance.guardrail: TRIPWIRE for future revisions: if a future revision ever moves this recommendation INTO emergencyTransfer, it violates the ejector-seat principle and must be rejected.

severityRationale: Low CONFIRMED by severity-auditor (high confidence). Not Medium: no availability impact, no attacker, the value leak requires a rare terminal event to have ALREADY fired, and it is preventable by runbook.
escalationTriggers: Any non-zero desiredAPYBps -- comes alive with the stream (DEDUP-04 annotation); re-weigh alongside L-01 and Q-02.

doNotCollapse.DEDUP-04: Different root cause: DEDUP-04 is uncapped-mint over-emission; this is a post-terminal double-pay.
doNotCollapse.L-01: Different leg: L-01 is a strand (value unreachable); this is a survival (value over-reachable).

poc.evidence: PoC demonstrates the bank survives emergencyTransfer untouched -- which is also what disproves V3-L-15's 'owner sweeps it' rationale for this asset.
